## Tổng quan về thành phần hóa học

<script>
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const molecules = [
        {id: "canvas_Row0", smiles: "O=C(/C=C/c1ccc(O)c(O)c1)O[C@@H]1C[C@](O)(C(=O)O)C[C@@H](O)[C@H]1O" },
{id: "canvas_Row1", smiles: "N#C[C@H](O[C@@H]1O[C@H](CO)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H]1O)c1ccccc1" },
{id: "canvas_Row2", smiles: "O=c1c(O)c(-c2ccc(O)c(O)c2)oc2cc(O)cc(O)c12" },
{id: "canvas_Row3", smiles: "N#C[C@H](O[C@@H]1O[C@H](CO[C@@H]2O[C@H](CO)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H]2O)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H]1O)c1ccccc1" },
{id: "canvas_Row4", smiles: "O=c1c(O[C@@H]2O[C@H](CO)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H]2O)c(-c2ccc(O)c(O)c2)oc2cc(O)cc(O)c12" },
{id: "canvas_Row5", smiles: "N#C[C@H](OC1OC(COC2O[C@H](CO)[C@@H](O)C(O)[C@H]2O)[C@@H](O)[C@H](O)C1O)c1ccccc1" },
{id: "canvas_Row6", smiles: "O=c1c(OC2OC(CO)C(O)C(O)C2O)c(-c2ccc(O)c(O)c2)oc2cc(O)cc(O)c12" },
{id: "canvas_Row7", smiles: "CC1OC(Oc2c(-c3ccc(O)c(O)c3)oc3cc(O)cc(O)c3c2=O)C(O)C(O)C1O" },
{id: "canvas_Row8", smiles: "O=C(O)C(=O)O" },
{id: "canvas_Row9", smiles: "C[C@@H]1O[C@@H](Oc2c(-c3ccc(O)c(O)c3)oc3cc(O)cc(O)c3c2=O)[C@H](O)[C@H](O)[C@H]1O" },
{id: "canvas_Row10", smiles: "O=c1c(OC2OC(CO)C(O)C2O)c(-c2ccc(O)c(O)c2)oc2cc(O)cc(O)c12" },
{id: "canvas_Row11", smiles: "O=c1c(O[C@@H]2O[C@@H](CO)[C@H](O)[C@H]2O)c(-c2ccc(O)c(O)c2)oc2cc(O)cc(O)c12" }
    ];
    const drawer = new SmilesDrawer.Drawer({ width: 150, height: 150 });
    molecules.forEach(mol => {
      SmilesDrawer.parse(mol.smiles, function (tree) {
        drawer.draw(tree, mol.id, "light", false);
      });
    });
  });
</script>
